measurement_notes: All latency observations use one runner, identical harness/profile and public production APIs; no counting allocator.
Three adjacent process-pass pairs AB, BA, AB; five samples/pass; ratios are medians of three paired ratios, not ratios of pooled raw samples.
Returned output drop and input cloning preparation are excluded; owned-input consumption inside the public API remains included.

Allocation observations are separate System-forwarding instrumented executables from full baseline and indexed runs, not paired latency executions; their CPU models differ and no timing comparison is made from these runs.
Requested allocation bytes and logical-live deltas are not RSS.
Compile wall times in builds have unequal cache warmth and are not a compile-speed experiment.
origin_scan_comparison_floor retains baseline-equivalent proxy meaning after indexing; it is not actual candidate comparisons.

canonical_output_oracles.assertion: Exact document, complete trace and directive SHA256 equality for each fixture across every baseline/candidate process; fixture geometry also identical.
